race.comment: FIRST DIVISION (11) did well to score at this track two runs ago before an even effort last time at Casterton in what looks a stronger race. Back a notch here and sets up well to trail a decent speed. DENSETSU (5) has been racing in great heart with two top-three finishes on end, the latest a second over 1000m at Wangaratta. Worth noting Lachlan King goes aboard who is 1/1 on the horse and he should take holding out.TIME ANGEL (7) ran very well first up then sat on the pace before fading to finish fifth last time out over 1000m at Wangaratta. Drawn wide but will push on and give a sight third-up. SWEET 'N' SPICY (12) finished 5 lengths adrift in eighth last time over 1200m at Mildura in a disappointing performance. Back to pet trip on the quick backup suits, respecting. SHADOW BLACK (8) has placed in her past couple and should be thereabouts again.
